finalText:
**Big. 1291 hits in 94 files, and most must stay.**

| Area | Hits | Rename |
|---|---|---|
| Service JS names | ~825 | Yes |
| SQL text in services | ~175 | No. Column is unchanged |
| `req.session` and `serialize` | ~200 | No. Public keys |
| `migrations` | 61 | No. Applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | No. Regenerated |
| `docs/openapi.yaml`, `lib/serialize.js` | 7 | No. Frozen contract |

Safe scope is local names only. A real column rename needs a new migration and a new dated API version.
